# Dictpad / 딕트패드

> A free, ad-free local talk-to-text notepad with no account and no
> subscription. Tap record and speak; the browser's speech recognition
> dictates live into a notepad you can edit at any time. Voice punctuation
> (period, comma, new line, new paragraph), a recognition-language picker,
> several named notes, autosave, copy, TXT download, JSON backup.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://dictpad.try-dabble.com/
Notes and preferences stay in this browser on this device. No accounts, no
sign-in, no uploads to the app's own server, no ads, no in-app purchases, no
recurring charge. Speech recognition is the browser's own service (Web Speech API,
SpeechRecognition / webkitSpeechRecognition); on most browsers that service
needs an internet connection, and the notepad shell itself opens offline.
It is an in-browser notepad, not a cross-app keyboard or system IME. Export
a JSON backup to survive a reinstall or move phones.

## Features

- Record / Stop: continuous live dictation with interim text shown in a listening strip and final sentences appended to the notepad
- Editable notepad (textarea) that autosaves on this device
- Voice punctuation: period / full stop, comma, new line, new paragraph, question mark in Korean, English, Japanese and Chinese command words
- Recognition-language picker (ko-KR, en-US, en-GB, ja-JP, zh-CN, zh-TW and more), separate from the UI language
- Several named notes: new, rename, delete
- Copy to clipboard, download .txt, JSON export / import (also accepts a plain list of notes)
- Stop cleanly ends recognition so the next Record always works; the session restarts itself when the browser ends a segment
- Screen kept awake while recording where the browser supports it
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker (cache dictpad-v1)
